column1: # The ley lines' stones (mods/base/src/ley.rs; notes/PROGRESSION.md "The lore", "Ley lines"): the star-born ancients' carved stone and the sleeping waystone that stands on a great crossing of ley lines. BLOCK_LIKE=limestone_side,cobblestone

column3: ley_stone_side|built|Ancient carved stone blocks laid by a lost star-born people: large dressed blocks of cool blue-grey stone (#3e4650 #586270 #76828e #919ca6 #aab4bc) in two staggered courses with fine bevelled joints a deep shade of the stone, weathered smooth edges, a faint thin inlaid groove of pale blue-silver (#8fb4c8) running along each course like a channel
column4: ley_stone_top|framed|The top of an ancient carved stone block: one large square slab of cool blue-grey stone (#3e4650 #586270 #76828e #919ca6 #aab4bc) with a bevelled rim, weathered, a faint inlaid circle of pale blue-silver (#8fb4c8) in the middle with a short groove running out to each edge
column5: waystone_side|face|A sleeping waystone's face: a tall standing stone of the same cool blue-grey ancient stone (#3e4650 #586270 #76828e #919ca6), its middle carved with one large angular rune of the star-born ancients (a circle crossed by four short lines running to the edges, like a compass of ley lines) cut deep into the stone, the rune's grooves holding a dim cold blue glow (#2f4a66 #4f7aa0 #7fb0d8), sleeping and faint, not bright; a few lichen spots (#7a8a5a) at the edges
column6: waystone_top|face|The top of a sleeping waystone: a weathered square cap of cool blue-grey ancient stone (#3e4650 #586270 #76828e #919ca6) with a bevelled rim, a small round boss in the middle carved with a tiny star of four points, its grooves holding a dim cold blue glow (#2f4a66 #4f7aa0)
